papers.title_en: CMD: An Integrated CGRA Framework with Cluster-Based Distributed Memory Design
papers.authors: Shangkun Li, Cheng Tan, Zeyu Li, Jinming Ge, Jiawei Liang, Hao Yang, Linfeng Du, Jiang Xu, Wei Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向粗粒度可重构阵列的簇式分布式存储架构与编译协同设计综合框架
papers.tldr: 粗粒度可重构阵列（CGRA）的性能常受刚性存储架构限制：能访问数据内存的处理单元数量与位置固定，导致访存密集的内核难以高效映射。为此，提出CMD集成框架，其核心是基于簇的分布式存储设计，并搭配协同开发的编译工具链，内含内存感知映射器和设计空间探索，可自动选取最优存储配置。实验表明，CMD经设计空间探索后相对传统CGRA平均提速1.39倍，总面积缩减至0.912倍。该工作证实了存储架构与编译器协同优化是释放CGRA计算潜能的关键路径。
papers.abstract_en: Coarse-Grained Reconfigurable Arrays (CGRAs) are a promising solution for achieving high energy efficiency and reconfigurability across various application domains, but their performance is often crippled by rigid memory architectures that limit the number and location of tiles that can access data memory. This creates a significant bottleneck for kernels with intensive memory accesses. To address this, we propose CMD, an integrated CGRA framework featuring cluster-based distributed memory design with a co-designed compilation toolchain. The compiler includes a novel memory-aware mapper and a design space exploration (DSE) mechanism that identifies the optimal memory architecture design for specific kernels. Experimental results show that our post-DSE CMD CGRAs achieve an average speedup of $1.39\times$ over a conventional CGRA while simultaneously reducing the total area to an average of $0.912\times$ of the conventional CGRA.

papers.title_en: PENDA: An Efficient Processing Element via Norm-of-Difference for Deep Learning Accelerators
papers.evidence: 提出基于范数差的新型深度学习加速器处理单元架构，直接面向人工智能加速器硬件设计
papers.tldr: 深度学习中内积运算占据主要计算开销，但现有硬件加速多采用近似方法，可能导致模型精度下降。PENDA提出基于差范数的处理单元，借助余弦定理将乘法改写为平方差运算，从而在不损失精度的前提下从算法与电路层面同时优化面积、功耗与时序。实验表明，在用PENDA替换传统乘累加单元的深度学习加速器PE阵列中，面积减少11~36%，能耗降低5~48%，时钟周期缩短11~19%。这项工作表明，通过数学变换可实现精确且高效的深度学习计算原语。
papers.abstract_en: Inner product computation dominates the computational cost of deep learning models; thus, accelerating this primitive is key to improving hardware efficiency. However, most existing techniques rely on approximations, which can degrade model accuracy. To preserve exactness while optimizing hardware, this paper presents PENDA (processing element via norm-of-difference architecture), which leverages the law of cosines to recast multiplications as squared-difference operations. Replacing multiply-accumulate units with the proposed norm-of-difference units yields 11~36%, 5~48%, and 11~19% reductions in area, energy, and clock period, respectively, for the PE array of a deep learning accelerator.

papers.title_en: FlexSpIM: An Event-Based Digital Compute-In-Memory Accelerator with Flexible Operand Resolution and Layer-Wise Hybrid Stationarity
papers.authors: Nicolas Chauvaux, Adrian Kneip, Charlotte Frenkel
papers.evidence: 面向脉冲神经网络的数字存内计算加速器，属于人工智能加速器硬件架构
papers.tldr: 脉冲神经网络的存内计算加速器虽有低延迟高能效优势，但电路和系统级灵活性不足，难以适配多样化边缘视觉负载。为此提出FlexSpIM数字存内计算架构，支持任意操作数分辨率与形状，统一存储权重和膜电位，并用层间混合权重固定或输出固定数据流最大化操作数复用。四十纳米流片显示较固定位宽数字加速器有更高吞吐及竞争能效，在DVS手势数据集上准确率为百分之九十五点八，大型系统能耗降低百分之四十五、延迟降低百分之五十二。该工作提供位级可重构与高能效低延迟的统一，为边缘视觉加速开辟新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Compute-in-memory (CIM) accelerators for spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer a promising solution for achieving $μ$s-level inference latency and ultra-low energy in edge vision applications. However, their limited flexibility at both circuit and system levels restricts their deployment across diverse workloads. This work introduces FlexSpIM, a digital CIM architecture supporting arbitrary operand resolution and shape within a unified storage for weights and neuron states (i.e., membrane potentials). These circuit-level capabilities enable a layer-level hybrid weight- and output-stationary dataflow, maximizing operand reuse and reducing costly on- and off-chip data movement during SNN execution. Measurement results from a fabricated FlexSpIM prototype in 40-nm CMOS demonstrate competitive 1-bit-normalized energy efficiency and higher throughput compared with prior fixed-precision digital CIM-based SNN accelerators, while providing bitwise resolution reconfiguration. Evaluated on the IBM DVS gesture dataset, FlexSpIM achieves 95.8% accuracy while enabling up to 45% energy and 52% latency reductions in large-scale systems compared with fixed stationarity approaches.

papers.title_en: GPU-Accelerated Gate-Level Time-Based Power Analysis via Event-Density-Aware Partitioning and Kernel Fusion
papers.authors: Weihao Wang, Yikang Ouyang, Hongyuan Liu, Yuzhe Ma
papers.evidence: 面向芯片设计流程的门级时基功耗分析GPU加速方法，属于数字集成电路设计与实现技术。
papers.tldr: 针对大规模电路时基功耗分析耗时长的问题，本文提出首个GPU加速门级框架，设计新数据结构支持高效状态相关功耗检索，采用事件密度感知划分调度线程，并融合功耗计算为单次内核调用。相比多线程PrimeTime PX实现最高37.63倍加速，兼具高精度，可加速功耗优化迭代。
papers.abstract_en: Power analysis is crucial in modern chip design flow. Particularly, time-based power analysis can provide fine-grained power consumption information to facilitate the diagnosis of power issues and guide power optimization accordingly. However, it may take tens of hours to conduct time-based power analysis on modern large-scale circuits, which greatly slows down the power optimization flow. In this paper, we present the first GPU-accelerated gate-level time-based power analysis framework. We propose a novel data structure to enable efficient state-dependent power retrieval. To accommodate the imbalanced event distribution across gates, we propose an event-density-aware partitioning strategy that allocates GPU threads based on gate event density. Finally, we fuse the power computation into a single kernel invocation to reduce redundant work in separate kernels. Experimental results show that our proposed framework achieves high accuracy while delivering up to 37.63x end-to-end speedup compared to multi-threaded Synopsys PrimeTime PX.

papers.title_en: WaferTrans: Enabling IOMMU-free Distributed Virtual Address Translation for Wafer-scale GPUs
papers.authors: Xinru Tang, Jingxiang Hou, Guanghong Wu, Yang Hu, Shouyi Yin
papers.evidence: 面向晶圆级GPU的免IOMMU分布式虚拟地址翻译微架构设计
papers.tldr: 晶圆级GPU依赖CPU-IOMMU进行远程地址翻译，集中式机制因跨晶圆层次和CPU资源争用成为瓶颈。WaferTrans提出无IOMMU的分布式地址翻译，通过PTE存在性一致性模型和每GPU的PTE存在性目录，实现晶圆内远程翻译查询。配合分布式映射与协同查询机制，消除CPU依赖。相较Trans-FW，平均性能提升2.5倍。
papers.abstract_en: Wafer-scale GPUs (WSGs) provide sufficient on-wafer bandwidth to make near-lossless Unified Memory feasible. However, existing designs still rely on a CPU-IOMMU to translate remote virtual-address accesses. This centralized mechanism scales poorly to tens of GPU dies: translation requests must traverse costly off-wafer hierarchies and contend for limited CPU-side resources, making address translation a critical bottleneck. We propose WaferTrans, an IOMMU-free distributed virtual-address translation design for WSGs. WaferTrans introduces PTE Presence Consistency (PTE-PC), a lightweight consistency model that tracks PTE insertions and removals, and equips each GPU with a PTE Presence Directory (PPD) that locates the GPU holding a requested PTE. It further employs a distributed PTE-PC mapping and a cooperative query mechanism to localize PTE-PC maintenance while preserving complete lookup coverage. Together, these mechanisms enable the GPU array to resolve remote translations within the wafer, eliminating its dependence on the CPU-IOMMU. Compared with the SOTA Trans-FW design, WaferTrans improves performance by 2.5x on average.

papers.title_en: Differentiable Partitioning with Placement and Hybrid Bonding Terminal Awareness for Optimized 3D Placement
papers.authors: Liwen Jiang, Xu Shi, Rufeng Xiao, Changhao Yan, Rujun Jiang, Zhiang Wang, Keren Zhu
papers.evidence: 面向混合键合3D IC的可微布局感知层划分方法
papers.tldr: 面向3D-IC的三维物理设计，层分配同时影响互连线长和混合键合端子分配。该文提出可微分划分框架，将分层决策松弛为连续概率，以放置信息为目标，引入双最大线长近似，并考虑混合键合端子拥挤的惩罚与跨层单元密度约束。用梯度优化完成分层和放置协同，OpenROAD测试中较两个最小割基线平均降低2.0%层间半周长线长，较最先进三维布局器降低12.1%。方法效果明显，且代码已开放。
papers.abstract_en: Research on 3D-ICs physical design has expanded rapidly in recent years. Hybrid bonding-enabled 3D integrated circuits (3D-ICs) offer substantial benefits in interconnect scaling and system integration, yet tier assignment remains challenging because it jointly determines 3D wirelength and hybrid bonding terminal (HBT) assignment. This paper presents a differentiable partitioning framework that directly optimizes placement-aware tier assignment for 3D-ICs through gradient-based optimization. Discrete tier assignment is relaxed to continuous probabilities, and a Dual-Max 3D wirelength model is introduced to capture per-tier half-perimeter wirelength (HPWL). In addition, a terminal-aware cutsize penalty selectively suppresses cross-die nets in HBT-congested regions, and a local balance constraint enforces grid-cell density equilibrium across tiers. Experimental results on OpenROAD benchmarks show that our method reduces D2D HPWL by 2.0% on average over two min-cut baselines and by 12.1% over the state-of-the-art 3D placer. We open-source our partition code with 3D placement flow to support reproducibility.

papers.title_en: Hardware Trojan Threats to Multi-Chiplet Photonic Neural Network Accelerators
papers.evidence: 分析融合光子计算与芯粒集成的多芯粒光子神经网络加速器所面临的硬件木马威胁
papers.tldr: 多芯片光子神经网络加速器（MCPNA）结合光子计算与异构集成以提升能效，但其分布式架构依赖第三方chiplets，引入硬件木马（HT）风险。本文系统分析HT在MCPNA中的威胁，按机密性、完整性和可用性三个维度分类。研究发现攻击可破坏光信号计算与通信，导致数据泄露或系统失效。该工作为光电子AI加速器的安全设计提供重要参考。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-chiplet photonic neural network accelerators (MCPNAs) combine photonic computation, photonic communica-tion, and heterogeneous chiplet integration to enable scalable and energy-efficient AI acceleration. However, their distributed archi-tecture and reliance on third-party chiplets introduce significant hardware security risks. This paper examines Hardware Trojan (HT) threats to MCPNAs across three dimensions: confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

papers.title_en: HDA-MoE: Hybrid Parallelism and Dynamic, Adaptive Scheduling for Mixture-of-Experts with 3D Near-Memory Processing
papers.authors: Haochen Huang, Shuzhang Zhong, Shengxuan Qiu, Zhe Zhang, Shuangchen Li, Cong Li, Dimin Niu, Hongzhong Zheng, Guangyu Sun, Runsheng Wang, Meng Li
papers.evidence: 面向3D近内存处理架构的MoE混合并行与动态调度，聚焦AI加速器架构及大模型推理性能优化
papers.tldr: MoE模型在扩展LLM时带来高内存需求，3D近内存处理虽有高带宽，但分布式组织导致现有TP/EP并行策略通信开销高或负载不均，且动态路由增加调度难度。提出HDA-MoE框架，结合离线混合并行映射与在线动态自适应调度，降低通信并提升计算利用率。在NMP架构上较TP、EP、混合基线和HD-MoE分别获得最高3.4x、1.5x、3.7x和1.3x加速，开源实现。
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have become a key technique for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs), enabling high model capacity with reduced computational cost. However, this efficiency comes at the expense of increased memory capacity and bandwidth demands. Recent 3D Near-Memory Processing (NMP) architectures, which vertically integrate memory and compute through hybrid bonding, provide high internal bandwidth and energy efficiency, making them attractive for accelerating MoE inference. Nevertheless, the distributed memory and compute organization of NMP systems introduces new challenges for mapping MoE workloads. Existing parallelization strategies, such as Tensor Parallelism (TP) and Expert Parallelism (EP), suffer from either high communication costs or unbalanced computation utilization, leading to inferior efficiency. In addition, the dynamic routing behavior of MoE models further complicates efficient deployment. To address these challenges, we present HDA-MoE, a framework that optimizes MoE execution on NMP architectures through hybrid parallel deployment and runtime scheduling. HDA-MoE integrates an offline hybrid parallel mapping algorithm with an online dynamic and adaptive scheduling mechanism to reduce communication overhead while improving computation utilization. Experimental results show that HDA-MoE achieves a speedup of 1.1x--3.4x over TP, 1.1x--1.5x over EP, 1.1x--3.7x over the Hybrid TP-EP compute-balanced baseline, and 1.1x--1.3x over HD-MoE. Source code is available at https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/HDA-MoE-TCAD26.

papers.title_en: A 28nm 27,648-Spin Multichip Digital Ising Accelerator with Pegasus Connectivity
papers.authors: Tong Wu, Atharva Raut, Ian Khor, Ziyad Alswaidan, Ting-Yu Lee, Hongchang Kuang, Navid Anjum Aadit, Anand Raju, Dhruv Chinmay, Siddharth Das, Ken Mai, Kerem Camsari, Tathagata Srimani
papers.evidence: 28nm四芯片数字Ising加速器，含时分复用自旋更新阵列
papers.tldr: 多芯片Ising退火面临连接度与精度瓶颈，传统方案在规模与求解质量间难以平衡。本工作基于28nm工艺，将27648个自旋集成于四芯片，采用时间复用自旋更新阵列、片上SRAM与调度化片间传输，实现Pegasus 15度连接与10位系数。实测吞吐率达41.5G更新/秒、能耗1.2皮焦/更新，可在3.3微秒内求得27069节点最大割实例的解。相较8度/5位多芯片退火器，连接度与精度显著增强，并通过可编程耦合支持优化与概率逻辑，展示了多芯片Ising加速器的可扩展潜力。
papers.abstract_en: We present a 28nm digital Ising accelerator with 27,648 spins across four chips. A time-multiplexed spin-update array with local SRAM and scheduled interchip transfers delivers 41.5G updates/s at 1.2pJ/update. Degree-15 Pegasus connectivity and 10b coefficients increase native connectivity and precision over degree-8, 5b multichip annealers. Programmable couplings support optimization and probabilistic logic, with a four-chip planted-MaxCut trace reaching the solution for 27,069 nodes in 3.3$μ$s.

papers.title_en: AI-Assisted Design of a Post-Quantum Cryptographic Accelerator: A Deployed-Silicon Case Study
papers.authors: Jungmin Park, Eunha Kim, Wooseop Kim, Seongjoon Cho, Byungho Cha
papers.evidence: 一个数字密码加速器的已流片硅案例研究
papers.tldr: 后量子密码迁移有明确时间表，但传统已知答案测试无法覆盖ML-DSA签名拒绝循环中的数据依赖路径，导致带缺陷的加速器通过全部KAT回归。本文提出用字节精确金标准预言机结合随机对抗浸泡测试替代原测试门，在统一ML-KEM/ML-DSA加速器上完成验证。结果显示301,343次数据相关签名零逃逸，且AI驱动的设计流程在232次实验中达到71.6%成功率，最终芯片字节精确且通过77万次检查。
papers.abstract_en: Post-quantum migration is mandated on published timelines, and silicon that ships with a defect cannot be patched remotely. The standard acceptance gate cannot detect an entire class of ML-DSA defects. Signing resamples until a candidate meets its norm bounds, so the executed path varies with the message, whereas known-answer tests (KATs) sample fixed values and reach only the depths their seeds trigger. Our accelerator passed its full KAT regression while carrying a norm check that outran block-RAM latency, leaving each candidate's final coefficients unverified; the escape surfaced at reject-loop iteration 5. The blind spot lies in the instrument, not the engineer; care cannot remove it. We replace that gate. A byte-exact golden-reference oracle paired with randomized adversarial soak drives the rejection loop past any fixed vector, closing the gap: 301,343 data-dependent signings, zero escapes. Because the gate judges artifacts and never authors, trust becomes separable from authorship, making AI authorship an answerable question. We report 232 logged experiments in which an agentic large language model drove a unified ML-KEM-768 and ML-DSA-65 accelerator with on-chip key custody from RTL to PCIe bring-up on one Kintex-7 XC7K160T, shipped at 98.5% slice occupancy. Success was 71.6%, following a hardware-coupling gradient, 77-85% for documentation and research against 50-53% for synthesis and bring-up, which observability can explain: failure concentrates where corrective signals are physical-side only. That so unreliable an author produced an artifact byte-exact across all six FIPS operations -- its deployed baseline surviving the same 779,945-check zero-failure soak -- is the claim.

papers.evidence: 面向Blackwell张量核的硬件感知低精度注意力优化
papers.tldr: Blackwell的FP4张量核心并不会自动加速注意力，因为Softmax转换与片上依赖在矩阵积缩小时成为主要瓶颈。为此提出硬件感知的FP4 FlashAttention-4：非因果推理使用Direct-P将分数直接映射为FP4概率，因果路径将前向量化直接传给反向以重建概率。在GB200上，前向吞吐达到BF16的2.13倍，单GPU 80亿参数更新加速1.14倍；稳定训练需保留FP8概率与值，所有MXFP4概率/值轨迹均发散。
papers.abstract_en: Blackwell's 4-bit floating-point (FP4) tensor cores do not automatically make attention faster because softmax conversion and on-chip dependencies dominate once its matrix products shrink. We address this with \emph{Direct-P} for noncausal inference and a causal path that passes the forward quantization directly into backward. Direct-P maps scores directly to FP4 probabilities and reaches up to 2.13$\times$ the bfloat16 (BF16) forward throughput on an NVIDIA GB200. The causal path reconstructs probabilities from saved quantized queries and keys and uses 8-bit floating-point (FP8) gradient operands, accelerating a complete single-GPU 8-billion-parameter update by up to 1.14$\times$. Matched distributed training retains FP8 probabilities and values; every tested MXFP4 probability/value training trajectory diverges.

papers.title_en: Interface-Aware KV Cache Quantization for Dense On-Chip NVM in Long-Context LLM Decoding
papers.authors: Jiahao Zheng, Yifan Qin, Xiaobo Sharon Hu, Yiyu Shi
papers.evidence: 面向片上NVM优化KV缓存量化，针对LLM解码内存带宽瓶颈，属AI推理存储架构优化
papers.tldr: 长上下文LLM解码中，KV缓存每步全量读取，成为带宽瓶颈。现有KV量化方法针对GPU设计，在NVM存储下开销大。本文提出与NVM接口协同的量化：密集片上NVM存储KV，固定码本，经随机旋转和逐向量归一化，仅需每向量一个标量元数据。4-bit量化在真实噪声下保持精度，KV读取能耗降低3.1-3.6倍，元数据开销比KIVI低8倍，但精度不如软件方法。
papers.abstract_en: The key-value (KV) cache is the dominant memory bottleneck in long-context large language model (LLM) decoding: every step reads it entirely, so decoding is memory-bandwidth bound. Holding a quantized KV cache in dense on-chip non-volatile memory (NVM) removes the off-chip transfer. Existing KV quantization methods, however, were designed for GPU-style memory systems: KIVI attaches per-group metadata, adding about 25% to the stored KV cache; KVQuant keeps sparse full-precision outliers that a dense array cannot hold in place. This paper examines what these structures cost when the KV cache resides in NVM behind fixed-range converters, and designs a quantization scheme matched to that interface. The architecture stores the quantized KV cache in dense on-chip NVM, uses a small static analog crossbar only for the fixed rotation, and keeps attention in on-chip digital logic. A randomized rotation and per-vector normalization give every coordinate the same range, so one fixed codebook for keys and one for values, each shared across all tokens of the corresponding tensor type, serve the entire KV cache. The codebook thresholds are programmed once as the read converter's reference levels, enabling fixed-range digitization with no per-token converter reconfiguration. Dequantization is a sixteen-entry lookup and one norm multiply; the only per-vector metadata is one scalar, about 3%. Across models from 3B to 14B and contexts to 32k tokens, the four-bit KV cache maintains accuracy under storage and crossbar noise simulated at realistic device levels. KIVI and KVQuant remain more accurate in software; the advantage of our format lies at the memory interface: 3.1-3.6x lower KV read energy than both mapped to the same NVM, and 8x lower metadata overhead than KIVI. The contribution is a KV quantization co-designed with the NVM memory interface rather than a new accuracy record.

papers.title_en: BLINK: Batch Normalization-based Integrity Checkpoints for In-Situ Detection and Mitigation of Diverse Weight Corruptions in DNN Accelerators
papers.authors: Marzia Khan, Akul Malhotra, Sumeet Kumar Gupta
papers.evidence: 面向DNN加速器的片上批归一化权重损坏检测与缓解方法，关联AI加速器硬件架构与可靠性。
papers.tldr: 深度神经网络加速器在安全关键场景会因老化软错误硬故障和对抗性攻击出现权重腐蚀导致自信但错误的预测。BLINK利用批量归一化统计的偏移监测在检测后同一次前向内重新居中层全程自主无需主机或微调数据。对各类权重损坏检测精度超过99%随机位翻转下精度由10%恢复至85.88%PBFA下从随机猜测回升到80%以上。硬件开销极小延迟增加低于2%，计算额外仅0.53%，显著提升AI硬件抗权重腐蚀的现场防护能力。
papers.abstract_en: In safety-critical deployments, AI hardware must remain reliable against a broad spectrum of threats such as aging, soft errors, hard faults, and adversarial attacks (e.g. progressive bit flip attack (PBFA)). All of these corrupt stored weights while the chip keeps producing confident but inaccurate predictions. Detecting and mitigating such weight perturbations is crucial for safety-critical platforms. To that end, we propose BLINK, an on-chip batch normalization (BN)-based on-the-fly detection and mitigation approach, which is based on continual sensing of the shift in the activation statistics, and targets a wide variety of weight corruptions (random and localized faults as well as adversarial bit flips). BLINK operates in two phases: (1) off-line pre-characterization of the relationship of the activation shifts with inference accuracy drop, and (2) on-chip runtime detection and mitigation of weight corruptions. Upon detection, the flagged layer is re-centered to bring it closer to its stored clean reference within the same forward pass. BLINK is fully autonomous, eliminating the need for host communication, operation halts, or access to fine-tuning data. If the residual shift after mitigation indicates that accuracy has fallen below a user-set floor, a held-out watcher aborts the inference. Evaluated on ResNet-20/50 and MobileNetV2 for CIFAR-10/100, BLINK detects harmful corruptions with >99% precision across all fault types. Further, it recovers accuracy from 10% to 85.88% under 0.5% random bit flips (Resnet-50/CIFAR-10), up to 84% for localized faults (MobileNetV2/CIFAR-10), and from random-guess accuracy to 80%-83% under PBFA (ResNet-20/CIFAR-10). Hardware overhead estimates indicate that BLINK incurs negligible costs, with less than a 2% increase in latency and only a 0.53% increase in computation overhead.

papers.title_en: GPU-Accelerated Hypergraph Partitioning and Placement to Map SNNs on Neuromorphic Hardware
papers.evidence: 将SNN映射到多核神经形态硬件的多核阵列上，优化核间通信流量
papers.tldr: 神经形态硬件上SNN映射需同时解决超图划分和核心放置两个NP难问题。现有工具串行且慢，难以扩展至百万神经元。提出GPU加速多级划分与递归二分初始化加交换精化的放置流水线，相比串行工具延迟降低16%以上，能耗降低42%，速度提升18-280倍。
papers.abstract_en: SNNs running on neuromorphic hardware use spikes to achieve sparse and energy-efficient communication over a mesh of cores. In turn, system performance heavily depends on the assignment of neurons to cores: the mapping. Since hardware features inter-core multicast and intra-core replication of spikes, we model SNNs as hypergraphs to exploit both opportunities for reducing communication traffic. Mapping thus comprises two NP-hard problems: hypergraph partitioning and placement on the lattice of cores. High-quality solutions to both are critical, yet increasingly difficult as networks scale to millions of neurons. Therefore, we propose a GPU-accelerated pipeline for SNN mapping: a multi-level partitioning scheme is devised around hardware constraints, while placement is initialized through recursive bisection, followed by refinement pulling together strongly connected cores through repeated swaps. Model-based experiments show upwards of 16% lower latency and 42% lower energy for spike movements over existing sequential tools, while our parallel mapper is on average 18-280x faster.
